summary: Comprehensive first-pass testing of NexusCRM. Backend: 38/38 pytest tests passed covering auth (signup/login/me), workspaces, multi-tenancy, RBAC (viewer cannot create), full CRUD for customers/leads/deals/tasks/notes, activity log with actor info, analytics overview, workspace invite (with stub user creation), and all three AI endpoints (score-lead, summarize-customer, sales-forecast) using Claude via emergentintegrations. Frontend: full E2E flow passed via Playwright — landing -> signup -> onboarding -> dashboard, sidebar navigation to all pages, customer create, lead create + AI scoring (score persisted with reason badge), deals kanban (6 columns, deal created in lead column), task create + toggle, team invite (member count grew), customer detail with note creation + AI summary, dashboard KPIs + AI forecast. No frontend errors on console.

minor.issue: Returns 422 (missing X-Workspace-Id header) rather than 401 for unauthenticated requests. FastAPI evaluates the Header dependency before the bearer auth dependency. Not blocking but semantically 401 would be cleaner.
Delete task allows role 'member' whereas customers/leads/deals delete requires admin/owner. Inconsistent RBAC — verify if intentional.

issues: 'Global search coming soon' placeholder input at top is non-functional; consider hiding until implemented.

action_items: Optional: normalize deleteTask RBAC to admin/owner to match other delete endpoints (or document that members can delete their tasks).
Optional: return 401 (instead of 422) when Authorization header is missing on workspace-scoped endpoints (currently the X-Workspace-Id Header(...) requirement short-circuits first).
Kanban drag-and-drop between stages was not exercised via Playwright (HTML5 DnD is flaky in automation); backend PATCH /api/deals/{id}/stage works. Suggest manually verifying DnD.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~680 lines — consider splitting into routers/ per resource for maintainability.
AI JSON parsing in /api/ai/score-lead does not wrap json.loads in try/except; malformed JSON would raise a 500 with a stack rather than a friendly error. Consider catching JSONDecodeError.

Invite endpoint auto-creates a stub user with a discarded random password — invited users cannot actually log in later since signup rejects duplicate emails. Need a proper invite-acceptance / password-set flow.
workspace_query default arg uses mutable pattern with `extra: dict = None` — safe currently but a small trap.
Frontend api.js: ensure token/workspace headers are cleared on logout (not verified here).
test_credentials: Created dynamic per-run users (test_<uuid>@nexustest.com / testpass123). No shared demo user relied upon. Note: pydantic EmailStr rejects .test TLD as a reserved domain — used nexustest.com instead.
seed_data_creation: Each test run seeds its own workspace with 1 customer, 1 lead (AI-scored), 1 deal, 1 task, notes, and invited members. Data is prefixed for identification but not auto-cleaned across runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and runs under pytest with the pinned pytest.ini (-n 2 --dist loadscope). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend uses data-testid attributes documented in the review request. If retesting AI features, allow 15-25s per call. EmailStr rejects .test TLD — always use real-looking domains.
